# Abuzar Industries

> Teak wood and timber supplier in Chitradurga, Karnataka, India, since 1995. Ghana, Togo and African teak in stock, Burma teak on order, plus white teak and neem wood. Dried to about 10% moisture and cut to any size.

- Address: Plot No 14, KSSIDC Industrial Area, DVG Road, Chitradurga, Karnataka 577501 (near Traffic Police Station)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98453 78626
- Email: abuzarindustries@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday-Saturday 9:30 AM-7:00 PM, Sunday 10:00 AM-4:00 PM
- Google rating: 4.8 from 56 reviews
- Delivery: charged by distance; regular deliveries to Hiriyur, Davanagere, Hosapete, Hubballi, Chikkamagaluru
